identity: A page from an Arabic children's / young-readers' magazine feature headed من الخليج إلى المحيط, compiled by دعاء الشريف. It is a miscellany of short illustrated items delimited by headlines and photo captions: a Qatari fort (قلعة الكوت) turned exhibition hall; the Ebla tablets and the oldest dictionary in the world; electric rays; Omani bridal jewellery in two categories; the 23 July Egyptian revolution (its causes, its six principles, its political measures); travel cards for مدينة العين in the UAE and مدينة الوادي / الألف قبة in Algeria; and finally a pen-pal profile card for an 11-year-old Tunisian girl. Register is plain expository MSA in short journalistic sentences. The page also carries bulleted lists, inline enumerations, and form-style label-then-value fields. Column reading order has merged some layout lines, so a few headlines, list bullets and form fields sit inside the same paragraph line as neighbouring material.
law: A sentence ends where a complete predication closes and the next word opens a new independent predication. Since every pre-<NL> position is already a given boundary, all real work is inside paragraph lines, and a break there is warranted in exactly four situations: (a) a headline or photo caption has been run together with the body text that follows it; (b) an asyndetic finite verb starts a fresh clause after an already complete predicate, especially across a tense or topic shift; (c) إن opens a new assertion; (d) a new form-field label starts a new field in the profile card. Coordination with و is NOT by itself a break in this document: the writer opens whole paragraphs with و and with كما (see the paragraphs beginning وتعتبر، والأعضاء، ومن أهداف، وتعتبر العين، والعين، كما سجلت), so و carries no information either way. A و-clause is cut only when it installs a fresh explicit lexical subject and a genuinely new sub-topic. Conversely, inline enumerations are always comma lists inside one sentence, never separate sentences: the jewellery items (الحلق شلاشل تشين خاتم واحد ساعة يد), the nine suburbs of Al Ain, and the run-together revolution goals are all single-sentence lists, exactly parallel to the bulleted items that happen to get their own layout line. Subordinators and relative material (التي، حيث، كما، وبمقتضاها، بالإضافة إلى، أو) never break.
reasoning: Site 11 (معرضا): the line reads القلعة أصبحت معرضا قلعة الدوحة الكوت في قطر قلعة قديمة… The alternative parse, VSO أصبحت معرضا قلعة الدوحة with a fronted predicate, would strand الكوت في قطر as a separate subject and split the proper name قلعة الدوحة الكوت. The natural reading is a headline القلعة أصبحت معرضا followed by a body whose mubtada is قلعة الدوحة الكوت في قطر and whose khabar is قلعة قديمة. Cut after معرضا. Parallel evidence: the two neighbouring sections do get their headline (أقدم معجم في العالم) and caption (نقوش مسمارية…) on their own lines, so a merged headline is expected where the line is missing. Site 42 (البريطاني): …كانت فيما مضى ضرورية للحماية من الأعداء ثم استعملت سجنا في أيام الحكم البريطاني is a closed past-tense predication; تستعمل اليوم مركزا لعرض… restarts asyndetically with a present-tense verb and an explicit اليوم opposed to أيام الحكم البريطاني. Asyndeton after a complete predicate is the strongest break cue available once punctuation is stripped; med only because a comma is not impossible. Site 99 (قرنا): تعود أهمية … إلى أنها تتضمن أقدم معجم … بنحو 30 قرنا closes the أهمية-تعود-إلى frame; عثر على الألواح في تل مردوخ بسوريا is a new asyndetic passive verb with a new assertion. Clear cut. Site 106 (بسوريا): وتدل الكتابات والنقوش التي عليها… brings a fresh explicit subject and a 24-token assertion after a 7-token locative fact, in a paragraph that would otherwise run 65 tokens. Cut, med — و is uninformative here so the decision rests on the new subject plus topic shift. Site 207 (والأنسجة) NOT cut: ولدى بعض الأنواع الكبيرة منها القدرة على إحداث صدمة كهربائية بقوة 220 فولت keeps predicating over the same referent chain (الأعضاء … منها back to القوابع), and ولدى X القدرة على is the classic comma-linked add-on; the whole paragraph is only 20 tokens, in line with the 26-token unsplit paragraph before it. Sites 250 / 273: the jewellery lists are not cut — the two parallel paragraphs القسم الأول هو… and القسم الثاني هو… have identical shape (definition, appositive list, then a وتتزين / وتلبسها closing clause), and القسم الثاني spells the apposition out with وهي, which retro-licenses reading والحلق شلاشل… in القسم الأول as the same list. Site 350-364 NOT cut: القضاء على الاستعمار وأعوانه / القضاء على الإقطاع / القضاء على الاحتكار / إقامة جيش وطني قوي are noun phrases governed by ومن أهداف ثورة 23 يوليو, i.e. one predication with an inline list; that the sixth principle إقامة عدالة اجتماعية وحياة ديمقراطية سليمة later occupies its own line shows the layout, not the syntax, decides where bullets get their own boundary, and inside a line an enumeration stays one sentence. Site 393 (ظبي): …وهي المدينة الثانية في إمارة أبو ظبي closes; قالوا عنها الكثير is an asyndetic new verb with a new (impersonal) subject, followed by its own epithet list العين الخضراء النبع لؤلؤة الصحراء, which is not cut for the same list reason. Site 396 (الكثير) NOT cut: the epithets are the colon-object of قالوا عنها الكثير. Site 435 (والنخيل) is the one genuinely balanced call: وتعتبر العين … وتنتج محاصيل … وتضم المدينة تسعا من الضواحي is a chain of three coordinated verbs, which MSA journalism routinely keeps in one sentence, but the third link re-installs a full lexical subject (المدينة) instead of continuing on العين and swings the topic from agriculture to suburbs, and the paragraph would otherwise be 29 tokens. Cut at lo. Site 452-490 NOT cut: everything after حيث in الخضرة سمة أساسية… is subordinate (حيث، بالإضافة إلى، التي، وبها), so 39 tokens form one sentence — proof that length alone cannot justify a cut here. Site 524 (ملغيرو): الوادي في منطقة سوف الواقعة… والتي تمتد واحاتها بين وادي غير وشط ملغيرو is a complete nominal sentence (or a caption); تظهر في الوادي مدينة الألف قبة restarts asyndetically and redundantly re-mentions في الوادي, which no single sentence would do. Cut. Site 540 (يحصى): إن مدينة الوادي … قد تأثرت — clause-initial إن after a closed predication is an unambiguous sentence opener. Cut, high confidence. Sites 638 (الموسيقية) and 648 (سليم): the profile card runs الاسم / العمر / الصف / الهوايات / العنوان / عمل الوالد / عمل الوالدة, and its siblings الاسم ريم الغربي، العمر 11 عاما، الصف الثاني الإعدادي، عمل الوالدة مدرسة each own a layout line; three fields have been merged into one line here, so the field labels العنوان and عمل must open new units exactly as their siblings do. Cut before each, high confidence. Site 610 (وحصلت) NOT cut: it is still governed by وبمقتضاها, mirroring the شكل of the preceding Sudan-agreement item. All 42 pre-<NL> positions and the final token 685 are carried as given boundaries.
